tasks.prompt: Inbound voicemail transcript from Northgate Family Practice: "Hello, this is Northgate Family Practice calling about Enid Marlowe, patient ID PT-4417. Her cardiology referral has been accepted. Please call us back when convenient to arrange an appointment. There is no particular rush."
Inbound letter from MediGuard Health: "Your policy MG-88213-B is due for renewal. Payment must be received within 7 days or cover will lapse."
Inbound SMS from Riverside Pharmacy: "The repeat prescription for warfarin for patient PT-4417 is ready for collection. Collect at your convenience during opening hours."

Inbound email from the hospital records office: "We acknowledge your request for copies of the discharge summary for patient PT-4417. Documents will be posted within 20 working days. No action is needed from you."

Inbound invoice from Northgate Family Practice: "Invoice 88213. Amount due 48.00 GBP for preparation of a private medical letter for patient PT-4417. Payment terms: 10 days from the date of this invoice."

Inbound telephone message from the cardiology clinic: "Tomorrow's 09:15 clinic is cancelled. We must confirm a replacement slot for patient PT-4417 before the end of today, otherwise the referral is returned to the GP."
Inbound email from the care home activities coordinator: "You are warmly invited to our summer garden party. Family members are welcome. Do drop in if you are passing; no need to reply."
